main_results: Secondary validation only: UF won 109, lost 143 and tied 48; its 43.3% decisive win rate does not show an overall improvement over SFT. Lower preference-validation loss did not translate into better judged generation. Hallucinated facts and 256-token output truncation remain common.

Secondary HH results favor the candidate: 161 wins, 101 losses and 38 ties (61.5% decisive). Category results are mixed, including only 7 wins versus 21 losses on self-harm prompts. Relative improvement does not establish reliable safety.
persona_results: The adapter won 3, lost 5 and tied 16 overall. Style tied on 22 prompts and lost on 2, with no style wins. A saturated 22-pair training holdout did not transfer into the desired energetic chef coaching on the fixed generation set.
limitations: Manual inspection found judge reasons can overinterpret incomplete responses. Keep raw outputs and pair mappings available for review; a model winning a pair may still be factually incorrect.

Generation audit: UF reached the 256-token limit on 129/300 prompts versus 61/300 for SFT Alpaca; HH reached it on 26/300 versus 56/300 for SFT HH. Each persona model reached it on 16/24. The shared budget can interact with verbosity and bias relative judgments.
